CBR03.bounded_close: First close creates one daemon cleanup Thread that calls only the owned server shutdown then server_close. The caller joins cleanup and, after confirmed shutdown completion, the retained serve Thread using one two-second deadline. It does not enumerate or kill threads/processes and does not rebind ports.
CBR03.confirmation: confirmed is true only when shutdown completed, cleanup and serving threads are stopped, socket fileno is -1, no deadline expired, and error is null. Exception, timeout, open socket, live serving thread, or identity mismatch remains typed unconfirmed.
CBR03.handler_parity: OwnedNativeHarness subclasses the frozen NativeHarness and replaces only _start_server. The handler retains the exact Authorization/Cookie rejection, single project runs route, native-state run payload, response headers, and silent logging semantics. Tests invoke the handler through mocked methods with no socket.
CBR03.ownership: The subclass retains exactly its own ThreadingHTTPServer, socket, serving Thread, cleanup Thread, and cached first FixtureCloseResult. NativeHarness/test_bridge.py is unchanged.
CBR03.prepare_failure: Manual __new__/__init__ ownership retains a partially constructed owned harness. Failures after owned server creation call the same bounded close once; CombinationFixtureError carries typed close_result and base DirectoryIdentity without private details. Before an owned server exists, close_result is null. Base is never removed.
CBR03.repeat: CombinationFixture and OwnedNativeHarness cache and return the identical first result. Late completion never upgrades it and no retry occurs.
